reviews.review: Probably my favorite game! I will always go test other games, play them a while, then come right back! Great game!

I think that this game is good as long as you buy all the DLC's along with the game to get the full experience and the ability to use everything at your disposal since there are a lot of servers that run with all of the DLC's and the weapons and vehicles will be locked from use which is a bit frustrating if you did not buy the DLC. All in all, great graphics, very immersive in a military standpoint, although quite demanding for a high end PC build but can still work with a decent mid to high range PC. I would give it a solid 8.5/10

Let's start off with the assets - great assets, great modding for them too (you just have to find some good ones), but this game ultimately falls with the Ai, it's genuinely embarrassing seeing how bad the Ai is, for me it kills the game. The campaign revolves around you fighting the Ai, and with them being able to 180, or snap directly to you when you are about 200m away and shoot instantly at you when you're behind them is ridiculous (Call it aimbot if you will :]), parts of the campaign are also poorly made, and/or sometimes nearly impossible or extremely frustrating to get through. I can't continue if there's a helicopter with an auto-cannon shooting HE grenades at me the second I move every time, add to that - the infantry shooting from across the valley and hitting almost every shot (Keep in mind they are not even marksmen).
The Ui (For commanding/team) is way too finicky, I don't want to scroll and click through 7 tabs just to get to my own team, let alone getting to the commands for them, in a combat situation, it is not good at all.

Modding aspect is good, multiplayer aspect is good (Finding a good milsim server is tough though, thats if you want to do that stuff), the editor is average at best, setting up respawns is a pain in the ass, and so far you can't even do it for Ai. If you're planning on getting this game for milsims or such, I would maybe recommend it, but if the modding or singleplayer aspect is your liking, I would not pay the full price, rather get it on a really cheap discount when it does come around.
